notes.title: 0.8 Save System Update
notes.notes:
Change Log:
Added "Silver Hooks" which are scattered throughout the dungeon allowing you to save your progress at them.

Added Ambient sounds to the void boss fight.

Added Various sound effects.

Fixed model errors on the south wing spiders.

notes.title: Basic Tutorial Update! and Second Boss fight Introduction. 10/8/2021
notes.notes:
Added:
  Basic Tutorial to the start of the game.*

  More enemy types to the east wing.*

  Hjorleif the Jotunn(Boss Fight in east wing).*

  Various Furniture models and other background models.* 

      Changes:
  Selected Equipment now swaps with the equipment in your hand.*

  Simplified dialogue.*

notes.title: Silver Vault 0.6 East wing and Proformance update of July 16th!
notes.notes:
Features:
Shields move while attacking.
Mouse sensitivity settings.
Sprint.
Humanoid Enemies.
Updated door model.
Key map in HUD.
Introduction of the East wing of the dungeon.

    Bug Fixes:
Door animations have been fixed.
Camera jitter have been minimized.

notes.title: Audio and visual Update! 0.5.11

  the spider model has been updated but still lacks animation.
